Unfortunately, the novelty of these AI classical channels has worn off for me.

Listen to enough of these, and then go back and listen to the true great works of classical music, and the monotony in these Ai tracks becomes inescapably apparent.

Among the great works there is a unifying sound, but there is noticeable distinction.
But these Ai playlists are basically the same 4-6 movements.

Appreciate the historical works ladies and gentlemen.
Go back to the great artists and even set out to make some of your own!

Thank you for taking the time to share this thoughtful criticism. Classical masterpieces are irreplaceable, and your point about greater musical variety is valuable as we continue refining what we create.
